svg.title: Tokens, cost and time with Compound
svg.desc: Each task's 8 pairs, with Compound ÷ without, on a log scale. Dot: median pair. Line: lowest to highest pair. Diamond: all 48 pairs with the six tasks weighted equally; its 95% interval is printed beneath. Time has no six-task figure. Claude Opus 5.5: Bug: refund split: tokens 1.42 times (pairs ranged 1.10 to 1.83), cost 1.53 times (1.30 to 2.00), time 1.42 times (1.10 to 2.23), 8 pairs. Bug: leap-year proration: tokens 1.45 times (pairs ranged 1.13 to 1.78), cost 1.45 times (1.27 to 2.15), time 1.37 times (0.90 to 2.41), 8 pairs. Bug: December due date: tokens 1.45 times (pairs ranged 1.01 to 1.53), cost 1.97 times (1.69 to 2.47), time 1.60 times (1.09 to 1.90), 8 pairs. Refactor: rounding helpers: tokens 1.05 times (pairs ranged 0.77 to 1.60), cost 1.04 times (0.83 to 1.21), time 1.07 times (0.82 to 1.27), 8 pairs. Review a Flask commit: tokens 1.60 times (pairs ranged 1.48 to 2.28), cost 1.58 times (1.39 to 1.96), time 1.31 times (0.75 to 1.51), 8 pairs. Question about Django: tokens 0.84 times (pairs ranged 0.70 to 1.07), cost 0.88 times (0.71 to 1.03), time 0.92 times (0.82 to 1.08), 8 pairs. All six tasks, weighted equally: 1.28× the tokens (1.22–1.34) and 1.38× the cost (1.33–1.44). Claude Sonnet 5.5: Bug: refund split: tokens 1.02 times (pairs ranged 1.00 to 1.17), cost 1.15 times (0.88 to 1.62), time 1.02 times (0.93 to 1.13), 8 pairs. Bug: leap-year proration: tokens 1.32 times (pairs ranged 1.15 to 1.61), cost 1.49 times (1.23 to 1.86), time 1.30 times (0.97 to 1.56), 8 pairs. Bug: December due date: tokens 1.06 times (pairs ranged 0.83 to 1.56), cost 1.56 times (1.30 to 1.98), time 1.17 times (0.11 to 1.58), 8 pairs. Refactor: rounding helpers: tokens 1.06 times (pairs ranged 0.80 to 1.14), cost 1.34 times (0.87 to 1.97), time 1.05 times (0.83 to 1.48), 8 pairs. Review a Flask commit: tokens 3.91 times (pairs ranged 1.60 to 4.87), cost 3.30 times (1.70 to 4.67), time 1.81 times (1.30 to 2.35), 8 pairs. Question about Django: tokens 1.40 times (pairs ranged 1.05 to 1.91), cost 1.46 times (1.20 to 1.93), time 1.34 times (1.06 to 2.08), 8 pairs. All six tasks, weighted equally: 1.37× the tokens (1.29–1.45) and 1.60× the cost (1.50–1.70). Cost: the API list price the client reported. Summed over the 48 pairs: Opus 1.28× tokens and 1.34× cost ($8.00 against $5.96), Sonnet 1.27× and 1.53× ($3.33 against $2.17). Always loaded: +369 tokens per request (Opus 18,590 → 18,959; Sonnet 18,543 → 18,912). The 0.11× time pair is one Sonnet December run without Compound that took 139 seconds, 137 of them in API calls, against 16 seconds with Compound.
